jobs.description:
Our Zurich Office employs more than 40 people across investment, investor relations and further teams. The modern office is situated at Bahnhofstrasse, next to Paradeplatz.

The role
The Intern will directly work with Ardian’s relationship managers for Swiss investors. Typical tasks include:

• Supporting Ardian’s Investor Relations professionals in developing and maintaining client relationships and fundraising activities in Switzerland

• Coordination of fundraising materials within the Ardian group (e.g., product/investment teams)

• Market intelligence and research on Swiss investor landscape

• Organizing and preparing events and other PR activities

• Tailoring materials to produce convincing, top-quality client presentations

• Administrative tasks such as client documentation and management reporting

• Own value-add projects and initiatives

Required skills
The ideal candidate should bring:

• Client-oriented approach and high quality standards

• Keen interest in private markets

• Ability to create convincing content; data visualization skills would be a plus

• Strong multi-tasking and organization skills

• Reliable team player with strong interpersonal competencies

• Good knowledge of MS-Office applications (especially PowerPoint and Excel)

• Excellent skills in German and English (verbal and written); French skills are a strong plus

Profile

• Final-year university student or recent graduate (Bachelor/Master) in Business, Finance or a related field

• Relevant work or internship experience in the financial services industry, consulting, marketing or a related field

• Domiciled and eligible to work in Switzerland

About the Team
As Intern you are an integral part of Ardian’s Investor Relations team in Switzerland, which is responsible for developing and maintaining strong, long-lasting partnerships with Swiss investors. Our Swiss team is part of Ardian’s global Investor Relations team of 160+ professionals. For further information on our team and its activities, please visit: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Other information
Competitive compensation
Lunch voucher

Application process
Using the APPLY link on this page, please submit your application documents in German (cover letter, CV, academic record and relevant additional documents such as certificates, reference letters, etc.), specifying in your cover letter the internship reference ( Ref: IR2027 ) as well as an indication of your earliest availability.

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il nostro ufficio di Zurigo impiega più di 40 persone per investimenti, relazioni con gli investitori e altre squadre. L'ufficio moderno si trova a Bahnhofstrasse, vicino a Paradeplatz.

Il ruolo
L'Intern lavorerà direttamente con i responsabili delle relazioni di Ardian per gli investitori svizzeri. I compiti tipici includono:

• Sostenere i professionisti di Ardian Investor Relations nello sviluppo e nel mantenimento delle relazioni con i clienti e delle attività di raccolta fondi in Svizzera

• Coordinamento dei materiali di raccolta fondi all'interno del gruppo Ardian (ad esempio, team di prodotto/investimento)

• Intelligenza di mercato e ricerca sul paesaggio degli investitori svizzeri

• Organizzare e preparare eventi e altre attività di PR

• Materiali su misura per produrre presentazioni client convincenti e di alta qualità

• Compiti amministrativi come documentazione del cliente e reporting di gestione

• Progetti e iniziative

Competenze necessarie
Il candidato ideale dovrebbe portare:

• L'approccio orientato al cliente e gli elevati standard di qualità

• Keen interesse per i mercati privati

• Capacità di creare contenuti convincenti; capacità di visualizzazione dei dati sarebbe un plus

• Forte multi-tasking e capacità organizzative

• Affidabile giocatore di squadra con forti competenze interpersonali

• Buona conoscenza delle applicazioni MS-Office (specialmente PowerPoint ed Excel)

• Competenze eccellenti in tedesco e inglese (verbale e scritto); competenze francesi sono un forte plus

Profilo

• Studente universitario di fine anno o laureato recente (Bachelor/Master) in Business, Finanza o un campo correlato

• Esperienza di lavoro o stage rilevanti nel settore dei servizi finanziari, consulenza, marketing o un settore relativo

• Domiciliato e idoneo a lavorare in Svizzera

Informazioni sulla squadra
Come Intern sei parte integrante del team di Ardian Investor Relations in Svizzera, che è responsabile dello sviluppo e del mantenimento di partnership forti e durature con gli investitori svizzeri. Il nostro team svizzero fa parte del team globale di Investor Relations di Ardian di 160 professionisti. Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro team e sulle sue attività, visitare: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Altre informazioni
Compensazione competitiva
Buono pranzo

Processo di applicazione
Utilizzando il link APPLY in questa pagina, si prega di inviare i documenti di richiesta in tedesco (lettera di copertura, CV, record accademico e documenti aggiuntivi rilevanti come certificati, lettere di riferimento, ecc), specificando nella vostra lettera di copertura il riferimento di stage ( Ref: IR2027 ) così come un'indicazione della vostra prima disponibilità.

Per migliorare le tue prospettive di reclutamento e prepararti a potenziali interviste, consulta il nostro Centro risorse . Là, si otterrà l'accesso a una vasta gamma di consigli, materiali preparatori e testimonianze.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Unser Büro in Zürich beschäftigt mehr als 40 Mitarbeiter in Investment, Investor Relations und weiteren Teams. Das moderne Büro befindet sich in der Bahnhofstraße, neben dem Paradeplatz.

Die Rolle
The Intern wird direkt mit den Relationship Managern von Ardian für Schweizer Investoren zusammenarbeiten. Typische Aufgaben sind:

• Unterstützung der Ardian Investor Relations Fachleute bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen und Fundraising Aktivitäten in der Schweiz

• Koordination von Fundraising-Materialien innerhalb der Ardian-Gruppe (z. B. Produkt- / Investmentteams)

• Market Intelligence und Research zur Schweizer Investorenlandschaft

• Organisation und Vorbereitung von Veranstaltungen und anderen PR-Aktivitäten

• Maßgeschneiderte Materialien für überzeugende, qualitativ hochwertige Kundenpräsentationen

• Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Kundendokumentation und Management Reporting

• Eigene Value Add Projekte und Initiativen

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten
Der ideale Kandidat sollte mitbringen:

• Kundenorientierter Ansatz und hoher Qualitätsanspruch

• Keen Interesse an privaten Märkten

• Fähigkeit, überzeugende Inhalte zu erstellen; Datenvisualisierung Fähigkeiten wären ein Plus

• Starke Multitasking- und Organisationsfähigkeiten

• Zuverlässiger Teamplayer mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Kompetenzen

• Gute Kenntnisse von MS-Office-Anwendungen (insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel)

• Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich); Französischkenntnisse sind ein starkes Plus

Profil

• Abschlussjahresstudent oder neuer Absolvent (Bachelor / Master) in Business, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Relevante Arbeits- oder Praktikumserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, Beratung, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Wohnsitz und Erwerbsberechtigung in der Schweiz

Über das Team
Als Intern sind Sie fester Bestandteil des Investor Relations Teams von Ardian in der Schweiz, das für den Aufbau und die Pflege starker, langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Schweizer Investoren verantwortlich ist. Unser Schweizer Team ist Teil des globalen Investor Relations Teams von Ardian mit mehr als 160 Fachleuten. Für weitere Informationen über unser Team und seine Aktivitäten besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Weitere Angaben
Wettbewerbliche Ausgleichszahlungen
Lunchgutschein

Anwendungsprozess
Über den APPLY-Link auf dieser Seite reichen Sie bitte Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen in deutscher Sprache ein (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, akademische Unterlagen und relevante Zusatzdokumente wie Zeugnisse, Referenzschreiben usw.), wobei in Ihrem Anschreiben die Praktikumsreferenz ( Ref: IR2027) sowie eine Angabe Ihrer frühesten Verfügbarkeit angegeben werden.

Um Ihre Rekrutierungsaussichten zu verbessern und sich auf mögliche Interviews vorzubereiten, wenden Sie sich bitte an unser Resource Center. Dort erhalten Sie Zugang zu einer breiten Palette von Ratschlägen, Vorbereitungsmaterialien und Testimonials.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Notre bureau de Zurich emploie plus de 40 personnes à travers les investissements, les relations avec les investisseurs et d'autres équipes. Le bureau moderne est situé à Bahnhofstrasse, à côté de Paradeplatz.

Le rôle
Le stagiaire travaillera directement avec les gérants de relations d'Ardiana pour les investisseurs suisses. Les tâches typiques sont les suivantes :

• Soutenir les professionnels des relations avec les investisseurs dans le développement et le maintien des relations avec les clients et des activités de collecte de fonds en Suisse

• Coordination du matériel de collecte de fonds au sein du groupe Ardian (p. ex., équipes de produits et d'investissement)

• Intelligence du marché et recherche sur le paysage des investisseurs suisses

• Organisation et préparation de manifestations et autres activités de relations publiques

• Adapter les matériaux pour produire des présentations convaincantes et de qualité

• Tâches administratives telles que la documentation des clients et les rapports de gestion

• Projets et initiatives à valeur ajoutée

Compétences requises
Le candidat idéal devrait apporter:

• Approche axée sur le client et normes de qualité élevées

• Intérêt pour les marchés privés

• Capacité de créer un contenu convaincant; les compétences en visualisation des données seraient un plus

• Fortes compétences multitâches et organisationnelles

• Joueur d'équipe fiable avec de fortes compétences interpersonnelles

• Bonne connaissance des applications MS-Office (en particulier PowerPoint et Excel)

• Excellentes compétences en allemand et en anglais (verbal et écrit); les compétences en français sont un fort plus

Profil

• Étudiant de dernière année ou diplômé récent (Bachelor/Master) en affaires, finances ou un domaine connexe

• Expérience de travail ou de stage pertinente dans le secteur des services financiers, le conseil, le marketing ou un domaine connexe

• Domicile et admissible au travail en Suisse

À propos de l'équipe
En tant que stagiaire, vous faites partie intégrante de l'équipe de relations avec les investisseurs en Suisse, qui est chargée de développer et de maintenir des partenariats solides et durables avec les investisseurs suisses. Notre équipe suisse fait partie de l'équipe mondiale de Relations Investisseurs d'Ardian de plus de 160 professionnels. Pour de plus amples informations sur notre équipe et ses activités, veuillez consulter: https://www.ardian.com/investor-relations

Autres informations
Compensation concurrentielle
Bon de repas

Processus de demande
En utilisant le lien APPLY sur cette page, veuillez soumettre vos documents de candidature en allemand (lettre couverture, CV, dossier académique et documents supplémentaires pertinents tels que les certificats, lettres de référence, etc.), en précisant dans votre lettre de motivation la référence de stage ( Ref: IR2027 ) ainsi qu'une indication de votre disponibilité dans les plus brefs délais.

Pour améliorer vos perspectives de recrutement et vous préparer à des entretiens potentiels, veuillez consulter notre centre de ressources . Là, vous aurez accès à un large éventail de conseils, de documents préparatoires et de témoignages.

jobs.description:
Department :
Customized Solutions

Location :
Zurich

Contract :
Internship (fixed-term)

Duration :
6 months

Start date :
March & July 2027

The role

Ardian’s dedicated Customized Solutions team based in Zurich develops and creates proposals for bespoke private market investment solutions that precisely fit our clients’ needs. You will support the team in its global fundraising activities from day one and will play a key role in the team, with responsibilities and opportunities including:

• Supporting the creation of tailored private market investment solution proposals (RFI, RFP, presentations) for large institutional investors worldwide

• Transforming complex investment ideas into convincing fundraising content in different private market asset classes including Private Equity, Infrastructure, Credit and Real Estate

• Developing concise marketing material for Ardian’s bespoke investment programs and working on a wide range of solutions for different client segments globally

• Updating the Customized Solutions’ proposal databases and supporting the development of internal tools and processes

• Participation in the team’s discussions and close collaboration with senior professionals in investment and specialist teams across Ardian

• Opportunity to broaden your knowledge of private markets and develop capabilities in a world leading private investment house characterized by a growth-oriented entrepreneurial culture

As part of an ambitious and dynamic team, our interns have the opportunity to bring in their own initiatives and can take on increasing responsibility throughout their internship.

Required skills

• Multi-tasking and organization skills; capable of managing deadlines and working under pressure on multiple tasks simultaneously

• Strong writing skills and ability to transform complex ideas into convincing high-quality content, combined with a high attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and efficiently; eager to learn on-the-job

• Reliable team player with a broad set of qualitative and quantitative skills, as well as strong interpersonal competencies

• Professional demeanor with excellent skills in English (verbal and written) as well as fluent/native in German and/or French; further language skills are an advantage

• Proficient user of MS Office applications (Word, PowerPoint and Excel); VBA skills are a plus

Profile

• Penultimate or final-year university student or recent graduate (Master’s or Bachelor’s degree) in Finance, Banking, Business, Economics or related studies with top academic credentials from a leading university

• Relevant internship experience in financial services, consulting or in marketing in comparable industries; prior experience with investment proposal processes (RFIs, RFPs and presentations) is a strong advantage

• Keen interest in private markets, with a basic knowledge of private market investments; previous exposure to fund of funds (primaries, secondaries and co-investments) is a strong advantage

• Eligible to work in Switzerland

About the Team
Ardian has been a leading provider of high-quality tailored investment solutions for private market asset classes for more than 25 years. Ardian’s dedicated Customized Solutions team is based in Zurich and is responsible for the global fundraising and development of bespoke client solutions with a variety of portfolio compositions, investment objectives and targets, including both diversified and focused portfolios. For further information on our team and its activities, please visit: www.ardian.com/customized-solutions

Other informations
Competitive compensation
Lunch voucher

Application process
Please send your application (CV and cover letter) by clicking on APPLY . Applications without a cover letter may not be considered by the recruitment team .

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dipartimento:
Soluzioni personalizzate

Posizione:
Zurigo

Contratto :
Stage (fisso-term)

Durata:
6 mesi

Data di inizio:
Marzo & luglio 2027

Il ruolo

Il team dedicato di Ardian su misura Solutions con sede a Zurigo sviluppa e crea proposte per soluzioni di investimento di mercato private su misura che si adattano perfettamente alle esigenze dei nostri clienti. Potrai sostenere il team nelle sue attività di raccolta fondi globali dal primo giorno e giocherà un ruolo chiave nel team, con responsabilità e opportunità tra cui:

• Sostenere la creazione di proposte di soluzioni di investimento di mercato privato su misura (RFI, RFP, presentazioni) per grandi investitori istituzionali in tutto il mondo

• Trasformare idee di investimento complesse in convincenti contenuti di raccolta fondi in diverse classi di asset di mercato privato, tra cui Private Equity, Infrastructure, Credit and Real Estate

• Sviluppare materiale di marketing conciso per i programmi di investimento su misura di Ardian e lavorare su una vasta gamma di soluzioni per diversi segmenti client a livello globale

• Aggiornamento dei database di proposte di soluzioni personalizzate e supporto allo sviluppo di strumenti e processi interni

• Partecipazione alle discussioni del team e stretta collaborazione con professionisti senior in investimenti e team specializzati in Ardian

• Opportunità di ampliare la vostra conoscenza dei mercati privati e sviluppare capacità in un mondo leader casa di investimento privato caratterizzata da una cultura imprenditoriale orientata alla crescita

Come parte di un team ambizioso e dinamico, i nostri tirocinanti hanno l'opportunità di portare le proprie iniziative e possono assumersi la responsabilità crescente durante il loro stage.

Competenze necessarie

• Capacità multi-tasking e di organizzazione; in grado di gestire le scadenze e lavorare sotto pressione su più compiti simultaneamente

• Forte capacità di scrittura e capacità di trasformare idee complesse in convincenti contenuti di alta qualità, combinati con una grande attenzione ai dettagli

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed efficiente; desideroso di imparare sul lavoro

• Affidabile giocatore di squadra con una vasta gamma di competenze qualitative e quantitative, nonché forti competenze interpersonali

• Demeanor professionale con eccellenti competenze in inglese (verbale e scritto) e fluente/nativo in tedesco e/o francese; ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono un vantaggio

• L'utente competente delle applicazioni MS Office (Word, PowerPoint ed Excel); le competenze VBA sono un plus

Profilo

• Penultimo o ultimo anno studente universitario o laureato recente (Master’s o Bachelor’s Degree) in Finanza, Banking, Business, Economia o studi correlati con le migliori credenziali accademiche di una università leader

• L'esperienza di tirocinio rilevante nei servizi finanziari, nella consulenza o nella commercializzazione in settori comparabili; l'esperienza precedente con i processi di proposta di investimento (RFI, RFP e presentazioni) è un vantaggio forte

• L'interesse per i mercati privati, con una conoscenza di base degli investimenti nel mercato privato; l'esposizione precedente al fondo (primarie, secondarie e co-investimenti) è un forte vantaggio

• Idonea a lavorare in Svizzera

Informazioni sulla squadra
Ardian è stato un fornitore leader di soluzioni di investimento su misura di alta qualità per le classi di asset di mercato privato da oltre 25 anni. Il team dedicato di Ardian su misura Solutions ha sede a Zurigo ed è responsabile della raccolta fondi globale e dello sviluppo di soluzioni client su misura con una varietà di composizioni di portafoglio, obiettivi di investimento e obiettivi, tra cui portafogli diversificati e focalizzati. Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro team e sulle sue attività, visitare: www.ardian.com/customized-solutions

Altre informazioni
Compensazione competitiva
Buono pranzo

Processo di applicazione
Si prega di inviare la domanda (CV e lettera di copertura) facendo clic su APPLY . Le domande senza lettera di copertura non possono essere considerate dal team di reclutamento .

Per migliorare le tue prospettive di reclutamento e prepararti a potenziali interviste, consulta il nostro Centro risorse . Là, si otterrà l'accesso a una vasta gamma di consigli, materiali preparatori e testimonianze.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Abteilung :
Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen

Standort:
Zürich

Vertrag :
Praktikum (befristet)

Dauer :
6 Monate

Startdatum :
März und Juli 2027

Die Rolle

Das engagierte Team von Ardian Customized Solutions mit Sitz in Zürich entwickelt und erstellt Vorschläge für maßgeschneiderte Private-Market-Investmentlösungen, die genau auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind. Sie werden das Team bei seinen globalen Fundraising-Aktivitäten vom ersten Tag an unterstützen und eine Schlüsselrolle im Team spielen, mit Verantwortlichkeiten und Möglichkeiten wie:

• Unterstützung der Erstellung maßgeschneiderter Vorschläge für private Marktinvestmentlösungen (RFI, RFP, Präsentationen) für große institutionelle Investoren weltweit

• Umwandlung komplexer Anlageideen in überzeugende Fundraising-Inhalte in verschiedenen Anlageklassen des privaten Marktes, einschließlich Private Equity, Infrastruktur, Kredit und Immobilien

• Entwicklung von prägnantem Marketingmaterial für die maßgeschneiderten Investitionsprogramme von Ardian und Arbeit an einer breiten Palette von Lösungen für verschiedene Kundensegmente weltweit

• Aktualisierung der Angebotsdatenbanken der Customized Solutions und Unterstützung der Entwicklung interner Tools und Prozesse

• Teilnahme an den Diskussionen des Teams und enge Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Fachleuten in Investment- und Fachteams in ganz Ardian

• Möglichkeit, Ihr Wissen über private Märkte zu erweitern und Fähigkeiten in einem weltweit führenden privaten Investmenthaus zu entwickeln, das sich durch eine wachstumsorientierte Unternehmenskultur auszeichnet

Als Teil eines ambitionierten und dynamischen Teams haben unsere Praktikanten die Möglichkeit, eigene Initiativen einzubringen und während ihres Praktikums zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

• Multitasking- und Organisationsfähigkeiten; in der Lage, Termine zu verwalten und gleichzeitig unter Druck an mehreren Aufgaben zu arbeiten

• Starke Schreibfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen in überzeugende hochwertige Inhalte zu verwandeln, kombiniert mit einer hohen Liebe zum Detail

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und effizient zu arbeiten; eifrig, am Arbeitsplatz zu lernen

• Zuverlässiger Teamplayer mit einem breiten Spektrum an qualitativen und quantitativen Fähigkeiten sowie starken zwischenmenschlichen Kompetenzen

• Professionelles Verhalten mit hervorragenden Englischkenntnissen (verbal und schriftlich) sowie fließend / muttersprachlich in Deutsch und / oder Französisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

• Proficient Benutzer von MS Office-Anwendungen (Word, PowerPoint und Excel); VBA Fähigkeiten sind ein Plus

Profil

• Relevante Praktikumserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen, Beratung oder Marketing in vergleichbaren Branchen; Vorkenntnisse mit Anlagevorschlagsprozessen (RFIs, RFPs und Präsentationen) sind ein großer Vorteil

• Keen Interesse an privaten Märkten, mit einem grundlegenden Wissen über private Marktinvestitionen; frühere Exposition gegenüber Dachfonds (Primär-, Sekundär- und Co-Investitionen) ist ein starker Vorteil

Ardian ist seit mehr als 25 Jahren ein führender Anbieter von hochwertigen maßgeschneiderten Anlagelösungen für private Anlageklassen. • Transformer des idées d'investissement complexes en contenu de collecte de fonds convaincant dans différentes catégories d'actifs du marché privé, y compris Private Equity, Infrastructure, Credit and Real Estate

• Compétences multitâches et organisation; capable de gérer les délais et de travailler sous pression sur plusieurs tâches simultanément

• Compétences d'écriture fortes et capacité à transformer des idées complexes en contenu convaincant de haute qualité, combiné avec une grande attention aux détails

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et efficace; désireux d'apprendre en cours d'emploi

• Joueur d'équipe fiable avec un large éventail de compétences qualitatives et quantitatives, ainsi que de fortes compétences interpersonnelles

• Déontologie professionnelle avec d'excellentes compétences en anglais (verbal et écrit) ainsi qu'en allemand et/ou en français.

• Utilisateur compétent des applications MS Office (Word, PowerPoint et Excel); les compétences VBA sont un plus

• Expérience pertinente de stage dans les services financiers, la consultation ou la commercialisation dans des industries comparables; l'expérience antérieure des processus de propositions d'investissement (IF, DP et présentations) est un avantage important

Ardian est depuis plus de 25 ans l'un des principaux fournisseurs de solutions d'investissement sur mesure pour les catégories d'actifs du marché privé. jobs.description:
Composed of more than 80 professionals, the Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries team is in charge of financial control, operational management and reporting across Ardian's Secondaries & Primaries platform and Customized Solutions. For Customized Solutions, the Fund Finance team also fulfills investor servicing and is in direct contact with the Investor Relationship Manager and the Front Office to manage the operations of Customized Solutions as a dedicated operational contact.

The role
Part of the global Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries team, the Zurich team is looking for an Intern to support the Fund Finance activities of Customized Solutions (ACS).

The Intern will support the team in all aspects of its Fund Finance ACS activities, including:

• Preparation of quarterly investor reports

• Support in the preparation of the quarterly valuation committee

• Support in the preparation of the board meeting for Customized Solutions clients

• Responsible for weekly cash controls

• Responsible for the controls, preparation and documentation of the diversification report
This list is not exhaustive and will vary depending on the capabilities of the Intern and the needs of the team.

Required skills

• The candidate should possess a broad set of quantitative, qualitative and interpersonal skills, and be a strong team player

• Intellectual rigour and discipline

• Ability to organise and perform work efficiently

• Basic knowledge of private market investments and general fund performance figures

• Strong analytical skills and competency in Excel, Word and Powerpoint

Profile

• Degree in business administration, finance & accounting or controlling

• Strong commercial understanding of Private Equity

• At least one previous internship in one of the following areas would be beneficial:
• Private Markets Fund Finance

• Audit in a leading audit firm (ideally financial services)

• Comparable experiences in the financial services industry

• Excellent English skills; German level at least B2

• Domiciled and eligible to work in Switzerland

Application process
Please send your application (CV, cover letter and any references) by clicking on APPLY.

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.
